name: M11-NOV-01a2b post-correction keyless fixture screen
purpose: Screen the three frozen public prior-art fixtures through the production novelty query builder and maintained PubMed MCP retrieval path after the query and retrieval corrections. This is fixture screening only, not a candidate-versus-baseline quality comparison or candidate acceptance.

query_builder.rule: Apply the committed builder to the frozen raw draft once; the resulting exact string is frozen below and sent unchanged through the configured ToolConfig mapper. No model query rewrite is used.

cases_in_call_order.raw_draft: In motor neurons with TDP-43 dysfunction, use of a cryptic STMN2 polyadenylation signal produces truncated transcripts and limits axonal repair.
cases_in_call_order.wire_query: TDP-43 STMN2 motor neurons dysfunction cryptic polyadenylation signal produces truncated transcripts limits axonal repair

cases_in_call_order.raw_draft: In airway epithelial cells, reducing TMPRSS2 activity should decrease ACE2-dependent infection by SARS-CoV-2 spike-bearing virus.
cases_in_call_order.wire_query: TMPRSS2 ACE2-dependent SARS-CoV-2 airway epithelial cells reducing activity decrease infection spike-bearing virus

cases_in_call_order.raw_draft: Interferon-rich tumors increase Qa-1b ligand display, engaging inhibitory NKG2A/CD94 on cytotoxic CD8 cells and weakening antitumor killing.
cases_in_call_order.wire_query: Qa-1b NKG2A/CD94 CD8 Interferon-rich tumors increase ligand display engaging inhibitory cytotoxic cells weakening antitumor killing

request_contract.path: Frozen raw draft -> committed _build_novelty_search_query -> current pubmed_fulltext ToolConfig parameter mapper -> one MCPToolClient call to maintained pubmed_search_with_fulltext -> configured ResponseParser.
request_contract.query: Send the exact frozen wire_query for each case; no rewrite, appended term, date filter, or retry.
request_contract.on_first_retrieval_or_rate_error: Stop immediately; retain the completed prefix, error class, and any available selected-rung evidence. Do not try another provider or query.
request_contract.initialization: MCP protocol initialization/tool listing is permitted; exactly one outer PubMed search-tool call is allowed per case.

selected_rung_evidence.source: Dedicated loopback MCP server INFO log for mcp_server.pubmed_query.
selected_rung_evidence.raw_server_logs: Read only the dedicated log's appended bytes for each call; do not copy or retain raw log lines. Keep only parsed rung metadata and the server's bounded selected-query field in the result artifact.

runtime_boundary.credentials: No provider or retrieval API credentials inherited; the only allowed secret is a transient COSCIENTIST_MCP_SHARED_SECRET for loopback MCP authentication, and it must never be printed or stored.
runtime_boundary.cache_requirement: Dedicated, newly empty cache used by the server for this screen; no colocated .env files in repository, engine, or MCP server directories.
runtime_boundary.server_log_requirement: Dedicated INFO log from the same isolated server process, started with unbuffered output; the runner does not retain the full log.

screening_rule.target_recall_at_3: Count cases whose exact target PMID appears among the first three parsed results, divided by 3 when all cases complete; report as incomplete otherwise.
screening_rule.abstract_mechanism_relevance: Independently review each returned abstract from the isolated cache against its frozen draft and label supports_central_mechanism, related_without_mechanism_support, unrelated, or insufficient_abstract. Preserve only the abstract SHA-256, label, and a short reason in the result; do not copy abstract text into the repository.
screening_rule.fixture_eligibility: A target is eligible for a later frozen positive fixture only when it appears in the first three and its primary-source abstract supports the draft's central mechanism.
screening_rule.control_comparisons: None in this screen; no control anchors are queried or compared.
screening_rule.abstract_retention: Abstract text remains only in the isolated /tmp cache and in process memory during retrieval; the committed and result artifacts contain no full abstracts.

interpretation_boundary: This direct maintained-MCP screen uses the shared production query builder and therefore tests the query/retrieval boundary. Full validator downstream judgments remain for M11-NOV-01a3/01b. Results are fixture screening, not a quality comparison, novelty finding, or candidate acceptance.
